title: Onboard aurora-pro-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Nair
body: This PR adds onboarding metadata and production performance profiles for aurora-pro-13b v1.0, plus automation to generate changelog entries for model registry releases. Motivation: aurora-pro is a high-quality 13B that we plan to include in the curated model catalog with Redwood-verified perf profiles optimized for our serving runtime. Changes include a canonical metadata YAML, multiple perf profile JSONs (gpu/quantized/half-precision), a changelog generation script integrated into the model registry CI, docs page, and a small smoke perf test. The changelog automation is triggered on new model version tags and produces release notes using templated summaries plus measured latency/cost stats from the perf pipeline. Testing: local perf runs, CI smoke, and changelog generation dry-run. Rolling plan: merge to main, run full perf harness on dedicated infra tagged with release candidate, and schedule a small canary rollout in staging before catalog publication. See linked Linear tasks for rollout and QA. No breaking API changes expected.
commits: c1a7f9a: Add aurora-pro-13b v1.0 metadata YAML and model manifest entries
f4b2d3e: Add perf profiles (fp16, int4-quantized) with sample throughput/latency metrics
a9d5b8c: Add changelog generation script and CI workflow hook; add docs page and smoke test
review_comments: Ethan Brooks: Left a few nits on the perf profile keys (use 'median_latency_ms' instead of 'p50'). Also request smoothing of noisy runs before committing final numbers.
Priya Nair: Thanks Ethan, swapped p50 -> median_latency_ms and added comment about sample size and smoothing. Updated perf JSONs to include sample_count and seed.
Sofia Martinez: Can we gate changelog generation on a signed tag so we don't accidentally publish from branch pushes? Also request test coverage for the script.
Priya Nair: Added tag-gate in CI workflow and a dry-run unit test for generate-changelog.py that runs against a sample perf artifact. CI workflow updated in this branch.
Liam Chen: Approved after CI green and small doc tweak. Verified smoke perf in staging cluster shows expected latency within 10% of profiled numbers.
ci_checks: perf-smoke: pass (queued on dedicated infra, 5m run)
release_notes: Onboard aurora-pro-13b v1.0 to model registry: metadata, perf profiles, and docs.
Added perf profiles for FP16 and INT4 quantized paths with measured latency and token-cost estimates.
Changelog automation: CI job to generate release notes from perf artifacts and metadata when model tags are created.
